name: Ponětovice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a white band into a green upper hoist part bearing five yellow stars in a cross and a red lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 30 November 2007 (decision No. 28) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
